ITEM 1 | Large white bowl about 22-24 cm across holding the meal; dinner-plate-sized footprint, used as reference | 0
ITEM 2 | Fresh dark green spinach leaves, flat and glossy, scattered across the bowl base and right edge, partly covered by other items | 45
ITEM 3 | Pale green cucumber slices, thin half-moon and wedge pieces about 5-7 cm long, smooth skin with lighter flesh, crisp-looking, lying on the lower right and top of bowl | 60
ITEM 4 | Dark reddish-purple kidney-shaped beans or olives, whole and smooth-skinned, about 1.5-2.5 cm each, glossy, scattered across the left and lower area | 70
ITEM 5 | Cooked chicken pieces, off-white to pale tan shredded or diced chunks about 2-4 cm, slightly moist with fibrous texture, scattered through the center and lower right | 110
ITEM 6 | Shaved pale yellow hard cheese in thin irregular flakes and shards about 2-5 cm, dry matte surface with slight crumbling edges, piled over the center and left | 40
ITEM 7 | Light brown creamy dressing, glossy and fairly thick, drizzled in ribbons over the chicken, cheese and greens, pooling slightly in the center | 35
ITEM 8 | Small pale mound of shredded coleslaw-like vegetable strands on the separate plate at lower left, thin orange and pale yellow strips, moist and tangled | 30
